name: app-insight-cards-carousel-stress-levels-in-navy-on-periwinkle
title: Wellbeing insight cards: a tall navy stress card between cream cards on periwinkle
whatItIs: A rounded periwinkle panel showing three vertical cards, the middle one solid navy with STRESS LEVELS text and a giant white 'High' at the bottom, flanked by cropped cream cards with a blue gradient orb and an orange line chart.
whatItMeans: Clear and calm; one huge word delivers the result immediately.
techniques: Give each insight one huge verdict word.
Distinguish cards by colour: navy for the focused one, cream for neighbours.
Crop side cards to imply swiping.
Use a single orange line for data.

vocabulary.definition: A single large word summarising a result.
Side cards cut by the frame to show more exist.
The active card given the strongest colour.
A card giving guidance based on data.
